checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard on the pavement
must.why: A wall-mounted ornate sign was added above the awning; no chalkboard on the pavement.

must.item: Words lie on sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: 'CAFÉ' sits flat on its board, but this is the wrong sign.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, shadow
must.why: There is no sign on the ground. The wall sign overlaps the window and covers part of the facade.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables, composition intact
must.why: The awning, tables and composition are unchanged. The only change is the sign over the upper window.

faults.what: Wrong sign type: a wall-mounted board instead of a freestanding pavement chalkboard
Wrong text: 'CAFÉ' instead of 'COFFEE TO GO'
The sign covers part of the upper window and looks pasted on

summary: The output adds a clean 'CAFÉ' wall sign above the awning and leaves the rest of the photo intact, but it is not a pavement chalkboard and does not read 'COFFEE TO GO'.
